properties.interpreter_rule: False-colour composite (NIR->red, red->green, blue->blue) of the latest clear Sentinel-2 scene per site, DLS centroid marked. Disturbance = contiguous low-vegetation (dark) patch around the centroid distinct from surrounding fields; where no such patch exists, the polygon traces the field parcel containing the centroid and disturbance_resolved=false. 10 m pixels cannot resolve wellheads or pads; all boundaries are interpreter estimates.
properties.note: Dark low-vegetation patch ~200x350 m around the DLS centroid; boundary gradational; adjacent bright-red oval may be reclaimed ground or unrelated. Pad itself not resolved at 10 m.
properties.superseded_by: Authoritative footprint wins: AER reclamation application site plan, OWA project boundary, or licensed high-resolution survey.
properties.crs_fix: 2026-10-08: corrected. The interpreted scene is on Sentinel-2 tile 11UQS (UTM zone 11, EPSG:32611) but its pixel polygon was converted to WGS84 with EPSG:32612, shifting it exactly 6 degrees east (~-107.4). Re-converted via EPSG:32612 -> metres -> EPSG:32611; the polygon now sits at its site. Shape and confidence class unchanged.
